items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.mountain_s: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Brown Fangs bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.mystic_ang: A ReaperAberration that got corrupted by the magicules of the World Destroying Dragon, but still kept their status as holy beings.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.mystical_b: An evolved Black Fang that has a deep connection to magic. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
An evolved Black Fang that has a deep connection to water. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
An evolved Black Fang that has a deep connection to the earth. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.mystical_d: An evolved Darkness Fang that has a deep connection to the dark. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.mystical_g: An evolved Black Fang that has a deep connection to wind. It can disrupt the magic of nearby enemies, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.mystical_l: An evolved Light Fang that has a deep connection to the light. It can illuminate its surroundings instantly, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.mystical_p: An evolved Purple Fang that has a deep connection to space. It can appear at any place at any time, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.mystical_r: An evolved Red Fang that has a deep connection to fire. It can destroy its surroundings in mere moments, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.nivalis_fr: An evolved Frost Wolf that has a deep connection to ice. It can freeze entire landscapes easily, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.ocean_spir: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Blue Fangs bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.overloadin: "The Reminder." When two brothers played, this one watched.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.penumbra_s: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Darkness Fangs bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.phantom.de: A demi-spiritual creature born in the Underworld by the magicules of the World Destroying Dragon.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.planet_spi: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Purple Fangs bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.preying_ma: An evolved mantis, leaning into its attack speed. It punches quick and deals decisive blows that almost guarantees victory.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.purple_cen: An evolved centipede, leaning into its offenses. It creates spatial distortions to disorient its prey before striking.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.purple_fan: A Direwolf that has a connection to space. It creates portals to move quickly.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.queen_wasp: An evolved scorpion, with the capability of manipulating gravity itself. It floats around aimlessly and randomly stings things it finds interesting. It has never been hunted excessively due to its nature, so its defenses are extremely weak.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.reaper_abe: One can only hope this thing does not find you. It has achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.red_fang.d: A Direwolf that has a connection to fire. It incinerates its surroundings for fun, making trouble for travelers.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.remnant.de: These lost souls piece their past back together slowly. They have regained some semblance of self-being, but it's still not enough.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.revenant.d: A husk of what could have been. Revenants carve their way out of the hell they have created for themselves, one soul at a time.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.rimeblight: A deadly, three headed dragon monster that thrives in the cold mountains of the tundra, using its 3 heads to Poison, Paralyze and freeze its foes.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.rimefang_d: A wingless dragon monster that lives in the icy tundras, thanks to its improved eyesight, its able to see its prey from far distances.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.scorch_wol: A Direwolf that has a connection to pure heat and energy. Simply being near one causes the environment to heat up. It can create deadly fire storms and harnesses pure scorch itself.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.scorchtail: A monster race that soars through the skies as it hunts for its next meal, diving down as it breaths its flaming breath on unsuspecting prey below.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.scorchtalo: A dragon monster race that scorches all those who come across it. Even its own kind is not safe from it.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.scorpion.d: Scorpions deliver strikes with their powerful stinger, which can inflict a potent venom on their targets. In rare cases, some even gain the ability to manipulate Gravity itself.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.sculk_worm: An ancient family of sculk inhabitants, where evolution has given them permanent darkness. Starts off weak, but grows to become a monstrosity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.seraph.des: Only the most powerful pure Angels with the most developed ego can attain Divinity.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.singularit: An evolved scorpion, with the capability of manipulating gravity itself. It floats around aimlessly and randomly stings things it finds interesting. It has never been hunted excessively due to its nature, so its defenses are extremely weak.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.soul_aberr: Very rarely, a Warden can evolve to an even bigger monstrosity. What this one will do with its power is still unknown. It is a demi-spiritual lifeform.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.soul_shrie: A sculk worm has tapped into their inner potential as a sculk inhabitant, and learned how to utilize its sound-based organs to fire projectiles.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.staff_offi: A high graded officer of the Phantom army.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.stag_beetl: An evolved beetle, leaning into its offenses. Their tough horn allows them to jab opponents to deal great damage.
A Stag Beetle that has gained a humanoid body. It can now funnel its strength into its fists, allowing it to dominate the battlefield.
A Stag Beetle that has evolved "the right way" and became a spiritual life-form. Its exoskeleton hardens evermore, capable of utilising Mithril Strength to further enhance its capabilities.
A Direwolf that has a connection to storms. Their tails can create strong winds when wagging and they are able to reduce their size.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.storm_spir: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Star Wolves bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.string_spi: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Guitar Fangs bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.sundeity_l: Having learned to fly without wings, it soars through the air, using magic to rain down light on its foes and save others.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.sunfire_li: A wingless spiritual dragon race that crawls across the ground, it helps those that it can, while also hunting for its own prey, it shows mercy, making sure to end the lives of prey quick and swiftly using rays of light.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.tempest_st: An evolved Star Wolf that has a deep connection to storms. It can create storms without a care, typically being a highly-feared and regarded monster.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.tengu.desc: The result of an angel possessing an Okami.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.tengu_sain: The result of a Tengu becoming once more a spiritual being.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.true_drago: A child of the stars and hopes of the world. A being that has achieved divinity, challenging the existence that brought you into this world.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.violence_d: What was once a sculk worm has truly disappeared. This is a monstrosity and there is no going back. It has achieved divinity, possessing an immortal physical body that will never age.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.volcanic_s: A truly scary being. This is a Direwolf that has "evolved the correct way" and become a Spiritual Lifeform. One is rarely born once in a millennium, and all normal Direwolves and Red Fangs bow to this creature.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.warden.des: Wardens are terrible creatures that inhabit the Deep Dark, always waiting and always ready to strike.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.wasp.descr: Wasps are frail insects that have the innate ability to fly. Though they aren't quick, they have great versatility, and it all exists to protect the Queen.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.whole.desc: Acceptance. The first step to becoming complete. When the remnants of your past collide together, only when you accept your struggles can you become Whole.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.race.yellow_cen: An evolved centipede, leaning into its speed. It swiftly dodges its target's attacks before paralyzing them, finishing the job.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.bullet_pu: You can only be fast, and go even faster. On the next attack, you speed up and deliver four quick attacks.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.butcher.d: Slice, dice, and feel your hunger. Your thirst for the hunt is unquenching, so grab a plate and have a taste.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.captivato: Your previous life, you were the brightest, shining star. Your ability to turn lies into truths… Perhaps it’s the other way around? Whatever it may be, your eyes shine brilliantly in response to being on the biggest stage.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.clangorou: Your soul, your beats. Your shell is hard, and makes wonderful noises when it is banged against. Maybe it can help you.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.coalescen: Freeze, stop and stagnate. Prevent hindering effects from applying to you and cause others to halt and solidify.
Use magicules to force differing stats to remain the same. Become nigh invincible for a short period of time while
Apply powerful Corrosion to your physical attacks. Turn into Corrosion and sear your enemies. Deal massive armor-ignoring damage with a Corrosion slash.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.corrosion: Channel your inner corrosion to burn and bleed the flesh off your enemies.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.crasher.d: The essence of "deletion". Completely and utterly erase your foes from the plane of existence with the power of your sheer will alone.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.cryogenic: Command your absolute authority over Deceleration, allowing you to freeze all enemies with ice and spew superchilled ice. Additionally, freeze the surroundings into ice
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.cultivato: Embody the relentless pursuit of ascension, gathering and refining energy to reach unparalleled heights. A Cultivator walks the path of self-perfection and dominion over all.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.darkness_: Boosts the power of Dark abilities by a large amount.
Boosts the power of Dark abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.discharge: Strike a bolt of lightning using your inner bio-electricity generated from a sac within you. Can be used without thundering weather.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.dissonanc: You are the calamity. You are the storm, and you are approaching. Strike lightning in all cardinal directions that deal massive Electricity Damage to all those unfortunate to be hit by it.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.dreamer.d: Dream a dream so grand it becomes a nightmare... Gain control over the forces of life and death, allowing you to cheat death and restore yourself back to a "save point".
Tinkering and tinkering. No one understood the machines as much as you did. In fact, no one understood you either. Perhaps it was always meant to be.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.exoskelet: The Insects of the other world all possess this tough Exoskeleton. It grows together with the user, and even allows them to wear armor on top of it.
The crops, the wild, everything was there for you. You sow the seeds and wish only for a bountiful harvest. And in turn, the crops bless you.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.gatekeepe: Wield the authority of kings and command treasures beyond mortal reach. Summon divine armaments from the vault, binding foes in chains of judgment while asserting dominion over all.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.gravitati: A black hole sucking everything into a singularity
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.gravity_f: Utilise the power of gravity to disrupt the target's movement and hamper their ability to move.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.hell_hall: Rupture the floor, raising your natural body temperature to liquefy all surfaces around you to molten levels.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.hidden_ru: Inspire your allies. Conscript allies in the dark. Copy abilities from your foes and Paste them onto allies.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.ice_domin: Boosts the power of ice abilities by a large amount.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.ice_manip: Boosts the power of ice abilities by a decent amount.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.jinchurik: That voice... It's familiar, yet something so distant. Another side of you, perhaps. But it's something that can be controlled. Provided you have the right tenacity to do it.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.kyurem.de: A husk of what you formally were. The leftovers, discarded without a second thought when the split happened. Coldness seeps through your skin as you freeze everything to reclaim your other parts.
items.lang|mysticism|mysticism.skill.lethal_po: As the King of Scorpions, your poison is highly dangerous. An upgrade to the Poison skill. Can only be used by King Scorpions and their evolutionary line.
